definitions.short: properly, to soften by rubbing or pressure; hence (medicinally) to apply as an emollient
definitions.full: H4799. marach [ מָרַח ] verb rub (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic (Talmud) מְרַח ; compare Arabic anoint, smear ); — Qal Imperfect עַלהַֿשְּׁחִין וְיִמְרְחוּ תְּאֵנִים דְּבֶלֶת יִשְׂאוּ Isa 38:21 let them take a cake of figs and rub it upon the eruption ( שִׂים in || 2Kin 20:7 ). — On מרוח see above מֶרְחַבְיָה מֶרְחָב, see רחב . מֶרְחָק see רחק . מַרְחֶ֫שֶׁת see רחשׁ .
